title: Virtual Care Safety Readiness: Emergency Contact and Safety Plan Settings
content:
Two safety settings are defined for each Virtual Care visit type: whether an emergency contact must be on file before the encounter, and whether a safety plan and emergency contact must be confirmed at the start of the encounter.

## Definitions

- **Emergency contact on file** — whether an emergency contact must be on file before the encounter (yes or no).
- **Safety plan and emergency contact confirmed at start** — whether a safety plan and emergency contact must be confirmed at the start (yes or no).

## Settings by visit type

| Visit type | Emergency contact on file | Safety plan and emergency contact confirmed at start |
|---|---|---|
| Portal E-Visit | No | No |
| Audio-Only Phone Visit | No | No |
| Primary Care Video Visit | No | No |
| Behavioral Health Video Visit | Yes | Yes |
| Specialty Video Follow-Up | No | No |
| On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care | Yes | No |

## Combinations that occur

| Emergency contact on file | Confirmed at start | Visit types |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Behavioral Health Video Visit |
| Yes | No | On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care |
| No | No | Portal E-Visit, Audio-Only Phone Visit, Primary Care Video Visit, Specialty Video Follow-Up |

No visit type carries the confirmation at start without the emergency contact setting.
